En cas de groupement conjoint, le mandataire sera solidaire, pour l'exécution du marché public, de chacun des membres du groupement, pour ses obligations contractuelles à l'égard de l’acheteur. e von 16 Ver- braucherzentralen und mehr als 30 verbraucherpolitischen Verbänden – darunter über 2.000 Orga- nisationen und sieben Millionen Einzelmitglieder - für einen starken Schutz der Verbraucher:innen in Deutschland. Der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband ist die Stimme der Verbraucher:innen – und damit eine entscheidende Kraft in der Politik. Wir wissen, was Verbraucher:innen bewegt und verschaffen ihnen Gehör bei Politik, Wirtschaft und Verwaltung. Strukturelle Missstände decken wir auf, benennen Verbraucherprobleme und entwickeln Lösungen. So tragen wir dazu bei, dass Märkte transparent und gerecht gestaltet werden. II. Ausgangslage Zur Selbstdarstellung und zur Unterstützung der politischen Interessenvertretung veröffentlicht der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband regelmäßig zahlreiche Kommunikationsmaterialien. Dazu zählen Publikationen, Social-Media-Grafiken, Flyer, Visuals für Veranstaltungen und Kampagnen sowie digi- tale Formate. Im Juli 2025 wurde die neue Marke Verbraucherzentrale mit einem überarbeiteten Corporate Design eingeführt. Grundlage hierfür ist die strategische Positionierung der Marke Verbraucherzentrale. Das neue Corporate Design setzt klare und verbindliche Gestaltungsstandards für die Kommunikation und unterstützt einen einheitlichen, zeit

ung. So können auch kurzfristige oder zeitkritische Projekte zuverläs- sig umgesetzt werden. Ziel der Ausschreibung ist daher der Abschluss eines Rahmenvertrags für Grafikleistungen mit zwei Losen. III. Laufzeit und Umfang des Rahmenver- trags Die zu schließenden Verträge für Grafikleistungen (Los I und Los II) haben eine Laufzeit vom 01.01.2027 bis 31.12.2028. Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband e.V. 5 | 17 Leistungsbeschreibung (Anlage 1) 2026-0997 Darüber hinaus enthalten die Verträge zwei einseitige Verlängerungsoptionen für den Zeitraum vom 01.01.2029 bis 31.12.2029 und vom 01.01.2030 bis 31.12.2030. Die maximal mögliche Vertragslauf- zeit endet am 31.12.2030. Der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband hat das Recht, die Verträge durch einseitige schriftliche Erklärung bis zum 30.09. des jeweiligen Vorjahres zu verlängern, d.h. die Leistungen zu den angebo- tenen Bedingungen auch für die Jahre 2029 und 2030 zu beauftragen. Der Verbraucherzentrale Bun- desverband ist nicht dazu verpflichtet, die Optionen abzurufen. Die Ausschreibung besteht aus zwei Losen. Los I (vgl. entity_geography.text: 2_Eigenerklaerung_Bezug_Russland-0422.docx ===== Entsprechend der Verordnung (EU) 2022/576 dürfen öffentlichen Aufträge und Konzessionen nach dem 9. April 2022 nicht an Personen oder Unternehmen vergeben werden, die einen Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift aufweisen. Dies umfasst sowohl unmittelbar als Bewerber, Bieter oder Auftragnehmer auftretende Personen oder Unternehmen als auch mittelbar, mit mehr als zehn Prozent, gemessen am Auftragswert, beteiligte Unterauftragnehmer, Lieferanten oder Eignungsverleiher. Ein Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift besteht durch die russische Staatsangehörigkeit des Bewerbers/Bieters oder die Niederlassung des Bewerbers/Bieters in Russland, durch die Beteiligung einer natürlichen Person oder eines Unternehmens, auf die eines der Kriterien nach Buchstabe a zutrifft, am Bewerber/Bieter über das Halten von Anteilen im Umfang von mehr als 50 Prozent, durch das Handeln der Bewerber/Bieter im Namen oder auf Anweisung von Personen oder Unternehmen, auf die die Kriterien der Buchstaben a und/oder b zutreffen. Bereits vor dem 9. April 2022 geschlossene Verträge mit solchen Personen oder Unternehmen mit Bezug zu Russland dürfen nur bis zum 10. Oktober 2022 fortgeführt werden. Protecting our environment is a huge responsibility, and we work with a number of organisations that carry out specific environmental functions. As of August 2014, we are also responsible for ensuring that the people of Ireland are protected from the harmful effects of radiation. Die betriebliche Weiterentwicklung der Systeme erfolgt unter Berücksichtigung der Empfehlungen aus der Architekturverantwortung des AN sowie der Vorgaben des ZDF. Die Umsetzung der jeweils zu beauftragenden Leistung erfolgt gemäß dem durch den ZDF-seitigen Projektleiter festzulegenden Vorgehensmodell, das auf die Notwendigkeiten des Projektes oder Vorhabens anzupassen und abzustimmen ist. Die Beauftragung und die Abrechnung erfolgen bei Bedarf im Rahmen des jeweiligen Projekts in Abstimmung mit und nach Freigabe durch den AG. Die zu erbringenden IT-Vorhaben werden im Q1 des Abrechnungsjahres als Grobplanung für den Zeitraum von 365 Tagen zwischen dem AN und AG abgestimmt. Bewerbergemeinschaften haben eine von allen Mitgliedern unterzeichnete Erklärung abzu- geben, in welcher sie die Aufgabenteilung innerhalb der Bewerbergemeinschaft darstellen, einen bevollmächtigten Vertreter der Bewerbergemeinschaft benennen und erklären, dass L-Bank Europaweite Vergabe einer KI-gestützten Lösung zur Verarbei- tung von Elterngeldanträgen und Nachweisen Seite 11 von 20 Seiten vertraulich alle Mitglieder der Bewerbergemeinschaft im Vergabeverfahren sowie im Auftragsfall ge- samtschuldnerisch haften. 3.4 Eignungsleihe / Unterauftragnehmer Ein Bewerber kann zum Nachweis seiner Eignung (wirtschaftliche und finanzielle sowie technische und berufliche Leistungsfähigkeit) die Kapazitäten anderer Unternehmen in An- spruch nehmen (Eignungsleihe). Diese Möglichkeit besteht unabhängig von der Rechtsna- tur der zwischen dem Bewerber und den anderen Unternehmen bestehenden Verbindun- gen. In diesem Fall ist der Vergabestelle nachzuweisen, dass dem Bewerber die erforderli- chen Mittel tatsächlich zur Verfügung stehen werden, indem beispielsweise eine entspre- chende Verpflichtungserklärung dieses Unternehmens vorgelegt wird. Die Unternehmen, auf die sich ein Bewerber zum Nachweis seiner Eignung stützt, müssen die Eignung hinsichtlich derjenigen Eignungskriterien erfüllen, zu deren Nachweis sich der Bewerber auf die Eignung des Unternehmens stützt. Zudem sind die Erklärungen über das Vorliegen von Ausschlussgründen nach § 123 Abs. 1 bis 4 GWB und § 124 Abs. 1 GWB auch für diese Unternehmen vorzulegen. Werden die vorstehend dargestellten Eignungs- anforderungen nicht erfüllt oder liegen Ausschlussgründe gemäß § 123 Abs. 1 bis 4 GWB vor, so ist das Unternehmen auf Aufforderung der Vergabestelle innerhalb einer von dieser vorgegeb

Duration of a supplier’s qualification A supplier's qualification is valid for a term of 5 years. After the 5-year period, the qualification may be extended for the same period after the administrative and/or technical files are updated. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. The supplier shall submit the new administrative and/or technical file within 2 months. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. The qualified supplier must continue to meet all qualification conditions/criteria throughout the qualification period. Many data points show that these efforts are bearing fruit. The metropolitan area of Wroclaw is growing, with now over 2 million people living within an hour’s drive. A 2019 survey19 showed that 82% of large IT corporations in Wroclaw chose the city because of the access it gave to qualified workers. In the case of international production companies, this rate can reach even higher. All respondents in the digital industry study pointed to the availability of skilled labour as a crucial factor behind their decision to launch an investment in Lower Silesia20. PRODUCT PERSONALISATION AND SERVITISATION The ability to create more product variants while using the same resources is crucial to building a competitive advantage. That’s why increasing production flexibility has long been a pressing matter for manufacturers. Again, data is the game-changer here. Processing real-time information at all stages of user interactions enables creating product simulations that can be adapted to match unique, individual requirements of the customer. Similarly, many manufacturing businesses now expand the value for their clients by shifting from selling products to selling Product-Service Systems (PSS). Pioneered in the 1960s by Rolls Royce, servitisation relieves customers of capital costs, instead offering them advanced solutions in a subscription model. 16 PLATFORMISATION OF PRODUCTION Just as products are now increasingly offered as a service, the manufacturing process is also subject to similar changes. ON INDUSTRY 4.0 WORLDWIDE Before the outbreak of COVID-19, there was widespread interest in Industry 4.0. The sector’s value was projected to grow up to $3.7 trillion by 20259. However, despite these positive outlooks, the actual landscape of Industry 4.0 adoption has been far more complex. ASPIRATIONS VS REALITY 90% of respondents in McKinsey’s10 annual survey admitted seeing the benefits of digital transformation in manufacturing. A majority of them included introducing new technologies as an essential part of their organisational development strategies. However, as research from the World Economic Forum11 demonstrates, despite these declarations, the reality was still far from this ideal. In 2018, the adoption of technology in production still remained slow across industries and regions. ip_data_security.text: This change wouldn’t be possible without advancements such as the Internet of Things (IoT), the Cloud, Robotic Process Automation (RPA), or Artificial Intelligence (AI). 13 Therefore, this publication follows the BCG’s definition of Industry 4.01, seeing it as a transformation that enables analysing data across machines and using it for more efficient manufacturing at reduced costs. CORE TECHNOLOGIES SUPPORTING INDUSTRY 4.0 Autonomous robots & cobots Digital Twins & simulation The AI-powered cloud Augmented & virtual reality Digital integration systems The Industrial Internet of Things Additive manufacturing Big Data & analytics Cybersecurity * ORGANISED AFTER THE BOSTON CONSUL TING GROUP Apart from increasing productivity, Industry 4.0 also encourages developing new products and business models. As a result, it modifies the workforce profile and reconfigures the competitiveness of companies and regions. These issues will be discussed later on in this chapter but first, let’s focus on the three core advancements differentiating Industry 4.0 from the previous revolutions. DATIFICATION Integrating data from devices, sensors, and IT systems enables developing new solutions at all stages of the product lifecycle – from design to production, logistics and maintenance. 1

ntinuously collecting, analysing, and using data in real-time. IIoT enables monitoring of all production processes and scheduling maintenance accordingly. When integrating Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and Customer Relationship Management (CRM), the network allows for comprehensive management of all related operations. THE CONVERGENCE OF IT SYSTEMS AND OPERATIONAL TECHNOLOGY (OT) In the past, IT and OT worked as separate entities: the first one mostly serving management, the latter controlling machines and resources. Thanks to the IIoT, these two worlds have been increasingly converging. Cyber-physical systems (CPS) embody this tendency as machines now combine both the IT and operational qualities. One of the most advanced CP systems – Digital Twins – enables creating digital replicas of physical objects but also processes based on data collected from sensors. ROBOTISATION AND AUTOMATION Industry 4.0 is also underpinned by a growing level of robotisation and automation. Apart from automated production lines, factories now boast autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and collaborative robots (cobots). EBVPD – Europos bendrasis viešųjų pirkimų dokumentas, aktuali deklaracija, pakeičianti kompetentingų institucijų išduodamus dokumentus ir preliminariai patvirtinanti, kad tiekėjas ir ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais jis remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį (VPĮ 88 straipsnio 5 dalies nuostatų taikymo atvejais ir subtiekėjai), atitinka pirkimo dokumentuose pagal VPĮ 46, 47, 48 straipsnius nustatytus reikalavimus ir, jeigu taikytina, 54 straipsnyje nustatytus reikalavimus dėl kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartų laikymosi, kurio forma prieinama interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Įgaliotoji organizacija – pirkimams organizuoti, pirkimo procedūroms iki sutarties ar preliminariosios sutarties sudarymo atlikti, taip pat atlikto pirkimo procedūrų ataskaitai ar skelbimui apie sudarytą sutartį ar preliminariąją sutartį pateikti perkančiosios organizacijos įgaliota organizacija, nurodyta specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose. Komisija – viešojo pirkimo komisija. Perkančioji organizacija – specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nurodyta perkančioji organizacija. Pirkimas – perkančiosios organizacijos atliekamas viešasis pirkimas. Preliminarioji sutartis – preliminarioji viešojo pirkimo-pardavimo sutartis (jei taikoma), vienos ar k

PĮ 49 straipsnį (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato tiekėjo kvalifikacijos reikalavimus); pasiūlymo teikimo metu žinomi subtiekėjai (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato reikalavimus dėl subtiekėjų pašalinimo pagrindų). fiziniai asmenys, kuriuos tiekėjas ketina įdarbinti Pirkimo laimėjimo atveju ir kurių pajėgumais tiekėjas remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 (kvazisubtiekėjai) (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato reikalavimus dėl fizinių asmenų, kurių kvalifikacija tiekėjas remiasi ir kuriuos, pirkimo laimėjimo atveju, tiekėjas ketina įdarbinti, pašalinimo pagrindų). EBVPD pildomas jį įkėlus interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Tiekėjas, pildydamas EBVPD, laukelyje „Procedūros tipas“ turi pasirinkti „Atvira“. Teikdamas pasiūlymą CVP IS priemonėmis šį EBVPD tiekėjas turi pridėti kartu su kitais pasiūlymo dokumentais (pasiūlymo pateikimo skiltyje „Prisegti dokumentus“). EBVPD nurodytą informaciją pagrindžiantys dokumentai kartu su pasiūlymu neteikiami. Perkančioji organizacija bet kuriuo pirkimo procedūros metu gali paprašyti dalyvių pateikti visus ar dalį dokumentų, patvirtinančių jų pašalinimo pagrindų nebuvimą, atitiktį kvalifikacijos reikalavimams ir, jeigu taikytina, kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartams, jeig

(e) Cesiune - înțelegere scrisă prin care Contractantul transferă unei terțe părți, în condițiile Legii nr. 98/2016, drepturile și/sau obligațiile deținute prin Contract sau parte din acestea; (f) Conflict de interese - orice situație influențând capacitatea Contractantului de a exprima o opinie profesională obiectivă și imparțială sau care îl împiedică pe acesta, în orice moment, s

Autoritatea contractantă notifică Contractantului decizia sa cu privire la înlocuirea unui Subcontractant/implicarea unui nou Subcontractant, motivând decizia sa în cazul respingerii aprobării. 15.5. Contractantul se obligă să încheie Contracte de Subcontractare doar cu Subcontractanții care își exprimă acordul cu privire la obligațiile contractuale asumate de către Contractant prin prezentul Contract. 10 15.6. Niciun Contract de Subcontractare nu creează raporturi contractuale între Subcontractant și Autoritatea contractantă. Contractantul este pe deplin răspunzător față de Autoritatea contractantă pentru modul în care îndeplinește Contractul. Contractantul răspunde pentru actele și faptele Subcontractanților săi ca și cum ar fi actele sau faptele Contractantului. Aprobarea de către Autoritatea contractantă a subcontractării oricărei părți a Contractului sau a angajării de către Contractant a unor Subcontractanți pentru anumite părți din Contract nu eliberează Contractantul de niciuna dintre obligațiile sale din Contract. 15.7. În prelucrarea datelor cu caracter personal conform Contractului, Părțile se angajează să respecte toate obligațiile stabilite conform legislației privind protecția datelor cu caracter personal inclusiv, dar fără limitare, conform prevederilor Regulamentu lui nr. 679/2016 privind protecția persoanelor fizice în ceea ce privește prelucrarea datelor cu caracter personal și privind libera circulație a acestor date și de abrogare a Directivei 95/46/CE (“GDPR”). 17.4. În contextul încheierii și executării Contractului, Părțile vor putea prelucra o serie de date cu caracter personal, precum datele de identificare și datele de contact de tipul nume, prenume, funcția ocupată, adresă de email, număr de telefon, semnătură a le persoanelor fizice desemnate în mod direct sau indirect, de către oricare dintre Părți în calitate de persoane de contact în vedere executării contractului precum și datele de identificare și date de contact ale administratorilor, di

n măsura în care Contractantul nu a dat curs solicitării de remediere conform pct. (i). În această situație plata aferentă costurilor remedierii vor fi suportate din garanția de bună exe cuție, Contractantul fiind obligat să o reîntregească în termen de 5 zile lucrătoare de la data la care i s-a comunicat efectuarea deducerii de către Autoritatea contractanta. 14 18.9. În situația în care Autoritatea contractantă constată existența unor vicii/neconformități ascunse ale bunului, aceasta are obligația să le aducă la cunoștință Contractantului în termen de 5 zile lucrătoare de la momentul la care le-a descoperit. 18.11. În ipoteza în care viciile/neconformitățile ascunse vizează doar o parte din bunuri, Autoritatea are dreptul de a rezoluționa parțial contractul, în privința acestor bunuri în condițiile prezentului Contract. 18.12. The Government of Uganda, represented by the National Information Technology Authority – Uganda (NITA-U), has received financing from the World Bank towards the cost of the Uganda Digital Acceleration Project – Government Network (UDAP-GOVNET) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for Consultancy services for the implementation of the National Digital Skills Training Programme (NDSTP)

responsibility of implementation of the National Digital Skills Training Programme (NDSTP) programme across Uganda. Website Hosting & Support Service The objective of this tender process is to invite proposals for the provision of website hosting, ongoing maintenance and development services for the CORU website. Tenderers shall demonstrate their capability to provide a secure, reliable, and resilient hosting environment that supports the continued availability and performance of the website. Particular consideration will be given to: • The location of the hosting infrastructure and the suitability of the hosting arrangement from a regulatory, operational, and data governance perspective. • The provision of secure and user -friendly content management functionality that enables authorised CORU staff to undertake routine and moderate website content updates without requiring specialist technical support. • The implementation of appropriate security controls, monitoring, and maintenance processes to protect the website from unauthorised access, modification, disruption, or malicious activi

sla_onsite.text: CORU's operational, regulatory and strategic requirements. 3.3 Key Requirements Of The Website Hosting & Support Service 1. Website Migration Services The successful tenderer shall be responsible for the migration of CORU's existing live website to the proposed hosting environment. The migration service shall include, at a minimum: • Development and execution of a detailed migration plan, including timelines, responsibilities, testing and implementation activities. • Migration of all website content, functionality, configurations and associated assets to the proposed environment. • Measures to minimise disruption to website availability and user experience during the migration process. • Comprehensive testing prior to go -live, including functional, security, performance, accessibility and user acceptance testing. • Provision of rollback and recovery procedures in the event of migration issues. • Preservation of existing search engine rankings and implementation of any necessary redirects and SEO protections during migration. • Post-migration support to address any issues arising following implementation. CORU's website is currently hosted on the Umbraco Content Management System (CMS). Tenderers should indicate whether they propose to retain the existing CMS o

Be fully supported and regularly updated by the provider and software vendor. 9 2. Hosting Services The successful tenderer shall provide a managed hosting service for the CORU website. The proposed hosting solution shall: • Be hosted within the European Union, with hosting in Ireland preferred. • Be secure, resilient and scalable. • Support high availability and business continuity requirements. Include proactive monitoring and management of the hosting environment. • Include automated notifications and alerting for outages, service degradation, security incidents or attempted attacks. • Maintain a minimum service availability commitment of 99.9% excluding agreed scheduled maintenance periods. Tenderers shall provide details of: • Hosting location(s). • Primary and secondary hosting facilities and data centres. • Backup arrangements and retention periods. • Disaster recovery arrangements. staffing_team.text: vastutab kasutajaliidese kujunduse ja kasutajakogemuse eest. Tarkvaraarendaja: vastutab front-end ja back-end arenduse eest. Tarkvaraarendaja peab omama kogemust Drupali-põhiste veebilahenduste arendamisel või liidestamisel ning vähemalt ühe kaasaegse JavaScripti raamistikuga (nt React, Angular või Vue.js) töötamisel. Tarkvaraarendaja peab omama teadmisi ja praktilist kogemust WCAG 2.2 AA ligipääsetavusnõuete rakendamisel veebiarenduses. Testija: vastutab kvaliteedikontrolli ja testimise eest (võib olla kombineeritud disaineri või projektijuhi rolliga). Pakkuja peab pakkumises esitama meeskonnaliikmete nimed ja rollid ning iga rolli kohta CV Lisa 6 vormil. Meeskonnaliikmeid võib hankelepingu täitmise ajal vahetada, kuid sellest tuleb hankijat eelnevalt teavitada. Asendav meeskonnaliige peab vastama vähemalt samadele nõuetele, mis olid esitatud asendatavale liikmele. Kogu projektiga seotud suhtlus, dokumentatsioon ja aruandlus peavad toimuma eesti keeles. Lähtekoodi kommentaarid ja tehniline dokumentatsioon koostatakse inglise keeles. Lisaks pakkumuses nimetatud meeskonna liikmetele võib tekkida vajadus kaasata hankelepingu täitmisel täiendavaid spetsialiste. Teiste spetsialistide kaasamist ei pea kooskõlastama ja nende kaasamise eest ei rakendata eraldi ega kõrgemat tunnihinda

3 Introduction Since 2007 Switzerland and selected EU Member States have been striving to jointly reduce economic and social disparities in Europe. According to the motto ‘do good and make it known’, this manual encourages Switzerland’s partner states to share results an d make them visible. The aim of this manual is to define the responsibilities, strategies and tools to make the general public aware of Switzerland’s cooperation programmes and to ensure transparency as well as consistent communication in the partner states. The manual specifies the requirements related to communication on the Swiss contribution to selected EU Member States. It states the general requirements and best practices related to the development of a communication concept, communication tools and t he provision of meaningful visual material. It also sets out the technical requirements on the use of the logo. 4 1. Public relations in the partner states 1.1. Roles and responsibilities The responsibilities of the National Coordination Unit (NCU) and executing agencies (EAs) related to communication are set out in Chapter 13 of the Regulations. The NCU shall designate a communication manager1 who plays a key role in coordinating, designing, promoting and implementing public relations regardi

hat several EAs jointly organise a launch event or closing thematic conference across several support measures. Lessons learnt and ideas from the Swiss cooperation programme 2007–19 ▪ Thematic conferences: These events give visibility to Switzerland and enable the exchange of knowledge, expertise and best practices at the same time. Consider also inviting Swiss experts to strengthen bilateral relations. This is particularly suitable for innovative support measures or support measures with less tangible results. ▪ Support measure visits: If the support measure involves visible results such as the rehabilitation of buildings, local residents or journalists could be invited on a guided tour or for an open day. ▪ Contests, field trips or educational events for students or pupils: This is a good way to combine awareness raising with Swiss visibility and to involve the audience emotionally. The messages need to be adapted to the different age groups. ▪ Study visits to Switzerland: Organise them at the beginning of the support measures so that the exchange of experience is useful for the implementation of the support measures. Aims and Objectives The Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) is designed to facilitate ease of access for conducting the training services without the need to submit a full commercial proposal. Admission to the DPS will be made on the basis of the Applicant’s capacity, as evidenced by a combination of turnover (financial and economic standing) and previous experience (technical and professional ability). The DPS lends itself to the dynamic nature of the Procurement Consultancy Services industry, allowing Economic Operators to apply, or re-apply, for admission to the DPS at any stage during its Term. 3.3. For the avoidance of doubt, the final Systems Audit Report shall be submitted not later than six (6) months following the end of the financial year under review. The Systems Audit shall include, but not be limited to, a review of the billing system environment, billing processes and controls, user access management, segregation of duties, data integrity, billing accuracy, tariff configuration controls, customer account management controls, billing adjustments and exception handling procedures, revenue assurance controls, interface controls between systems, audit trails, change management procedures, reporting controls, business continuity arrangements, backup and recovery procedures, and compliance with applicable policies, procedures and regulatory requirements. The Contractor shall assess the adequacy, effectiveness and reliability of the controls in place and identify any weaknesses, risks or areas for improvement. The Contractor shall submit a Systems Audit Report detailing findings, risks, recommendations, proposed corrective actions and, where appropriate, prioritisation of recommendations based on their significance and potential impact. The Committees Oaklee’s Board Committees provide focused oversight across key areas of organisational activity. The Housing Delivery Committee met three times during the reporting period. Its remit includes approving the housing development pipeline and projects, considering the feasibility of new business, and making recommendations to the Board for projects with large capital budget and borrowing implications. The Audit & Risk Committee met three times during the reporting period. Its remit is to provide oversight and assurance for the work of Oaklee and to advise the Board on risk management, as well as internal and external audit. The Housing Services Committee met three times during the reporting period. It provides oversight to the Board on resident, housing, customer, property and asset services. The Committee encourages Resident engagement and feedback, and provides a focus on qualitative outcomes and quantitative performance. Two Resident representatives are members of the Committee. The purpose of this procedure is to establish a Panel of Trainers for the provision of Training Services for the Local Enterprise Office in Leitrim County Council. LEO Leitrim is compiling a panel of trainers, from which future training programmes, workshops and seminars for a maximum of a 3 year period will be selected . Applications are invited from those with appropriate skills and experience that wish to be included in the LEO Leitrim Training panel. For the purposes of this document, the term “Trainer” refers to any Applicant admitted to the Panel and engaged by Local Enterprise Office Leitrim to deliver training services. References to Tenderer, Consultant or Applicant shall be interpreted accordingly. The proposed Training Services include but are not limited to those set out in section below. The Leitrim Local Enterprise Office serves as a first stop shop to provide support and services to start, grow and develop micro and small businesses in County Leitrim. LEO Leitrim Training Services are aimed at improving owner-manager skills to assist the survival and growth of micro- businesses. As per the Enterprise Development Plan, the provision of training is a fundamental aspect of LEO supports to entrepreneurs in the county. The Local Enterprise Office cur

embers capable of delivering the services [subject to that number being on the panel]. As and when additional programmes arise over the life of the Panel, LEO Leitrim will either award these programmes to the initial firm identified to deliver the programme or identify the most appropriate service provider on the panel based on availability, reliability & quality of programme / trainer based on the specific needs and by reference to the original tenders. Other Requirements Which Arise LEO Leitrim recognises that training & business needs are constantly evolving and this in turn may require changes to our training offerings. LEO Leitrim reserves therefore, the right to run a mini -tender competition for additional training programmes falling within the scope of this contract at all times. Therefore, the service is not fully subject to the provisions of Directive 2014/24/EU. Given the strategic partnership of this service, the Contracting Authority considers the creation of a Panel as the most appropriate and workable procurement process for the provision of eBooks. A Panel constitutes a means of assessing the financial and technical capacity of a number of economic operators to whom individual contracts may or may not be awarded over the Panel’s duration. The Contracting Authority is planning to run a two-stage tender process. In the initial stage, all providers who meet the Selection Criteria included in the Qualification Questionnaire Document will be admitted to the Panel. The second stage of this competition is Contracts. Contracts will be signed by the Contracting Authority with each provider, identifying the terms and conditions including the scope of the services, costs and any other operations terms required. Revenue requires a platform for 200 users that provides access to relevant, high -quality learning content on current technologies and industry practices. The platform should have a clear, intuitive catalogue that enables users to easily search for and access relevant learning materia ls. The Government shall have the right, without the prior written consent of the Contractor or its authorized resellers, to assign, reassign, or transfer software licenses among Government employees or the Government's rights in the Contractor's product to any governmental organization that is managed, operated, or controlled by the Government. Such authorization includes sublicensing, and assignment or transfer among or between authorized users. Empower acknowledges the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development adopted by all UN Member States in 2015, which provides a blueprint for peace and prosperity for people and the plant. insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

entity_geography.text: ealthcare Training Services Contract or concession notice – standard regime 1 Buyer 1.1 Buyer Official name: Leading Healthcare Providers Skillnet Legal type of the buyer: Body governed by public law, controlled by a central government authority Activity of the contracting authority: Education 2 Procedure 2.1 Procedure Title: 2026 ­ 2028 Dynamic Purchasing System for Healthcare Training Services Description: LHP Skillnet is establishing a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) to facilitate the provision of services for the period 2026 to 2028. The DPS will provide an ongoing mechanism that allows suitably qualified suppliers who meet the minimum eligibility and quality thresholds to apply for admission at any time during the life of the system. Unlike a traditional framework agreement, the DPS is fully electronic and remains open throughout its duration. Once admitted to the DPS, suppliers may be invited to participate in mini competitions for specific training requirements as they arise. Contracts will be awarded following these mini competitions in accordance with the applicable procurement rules. The DPS will operate in line with the provisions of the relevant procurement directives and will remain in place for a period of three years. Suppliers may join or leave the DPS at any stage du

Commissioning: Commissioning is a process that involves the entire Design Team throughout the planning, design, construction and occupancy of the project. Commissioning Guidelines for AOC Projects are contained in the policy statement of June 7, 2010. During the initial planning process, the AOC Project Team shall determine the purpose and role of commissioning. The purpose may be to ensure proper integration of a small renovation/rehabilitation into the Capitol 7 AOC Order 28-8, December 26, 2018 complex, or it may be related to a certification. It may range from simple, direct Owner commissioning by the AOC to an independent Commissioning Agent with a substantial budget. As a rule, if a project is designed by an Associate A/E, then commissioning will be performed by a third party hired by the AOC. Within the context of design for mechanical systems, commissioning plays a significant role. The designer of the mechanical system has these responsibilities: i. Develop and document the Program of Requirements (PoR.) ii. Develop a basis of design. Commissioning shall help ensure that mechanical systems operate properly as a holistic system. To meet these ESR bunch injection schemes and requirements, an array of stripline-based kickers, individually fed by high voltage (HV) pulse signals of up to +/-30 kV, will be installed in the ESR. The required deflection angle is in the range 1- 1.5 mrad, for the individual stripline kicker we target a deflection angle of ~125 µrad @ 18 GeV, assuming +/-27 kV pulse supply voltage between the kicker electrodes. An Autotransfusion Units also known as an autologous blood recovery system, is a system that provides hospitals with an easy-to-use, reliable way to recover a patient’s own high-quality blood during medium to high blood loss procedures, including cardiac, orthopedic, trauma, transplant, vascular and OBGYN surgeries. Once recovered, the blood is washed and delivered to a product bag. The complete system is designed to be intuitive and flexible for optimal performance, supporting exceptional patient care. Wdrożenie zabezpieczenia tymczasowego nie zastępuje obowiązku trwałego usunięcia podatności. Jeżeli trwałe usunięcie podatności zależy od udostępnienia poprawki przez producenta komponentu, zmiana terminu wymaga udokumentowanego uzasadnienia, utrzymania skutecznego zabezpieczenia tymczasowego oraz pisemnej akceptacji Zamawiającego. Usunięcie podatności musi zostać potwierdzone ponowną weryfikacją i udokumentowane. Powyższe terminy obowiązują niezależnie od terminów obsługi awarii określonych w SLA i nie zmieniają warunków odbioru końcowego, w szczególności zakazu występowania podatności Critical i High. Wykonawca przystępuje do realizacji prac wyłącznie na podstawie zlecenia Zamawiającego, o którym mowa w ust. 8. Ocena spełniania warunków udziału w postępowania i przesłanek wykluczenia dokonywana będzie w formule „spełnia - nie spełnia”, w oparciu o oświadczenia i dokumenty, o których mowa w pkt. 12 i 13 SWZ. 3. Opis przedmiotu zamówienia: 3.1. Przedmiotem zamówienia jest wykonanie, wdrożenie oraz utrzymanie strony internetowej Zamawiającego, polegające na zaprojektowaniu, wykonaniu, wdrożeniu, uruchomieniu, hostingu oraz utrzymaniu nowej strony internetowej Zamawiającego oraz serwisu Biuletynu Informacji Publicznej, a także dostarczenie i uruchomienie systemu zarządzania treścią (CMS), umożliwiającą samodzielną obsługę obu serwisów przez Zamawiającego, dalej: „Przedmiot Umowy” 3.2. Szczegółowy opis przedmiotu zamówienia stanowi załącznik 1 do SWZ. 3.3. Równoważność 3.3.1. Za równoważne Zamawiający uzna produkty posiadające parametry wydajności, wytrzymałości i niezawodności nie gorsze niż wskazane produkty, dla których instalacja/urządzenie, w ramach której będą instalowane nie będzie wymagała dodatkowego dostosowania zarówno głównego urzą

patrzone sformułowaniem „lub równoważne”. 3.3.4. W sytuacjach, gdy Zamawiający opisuje przedmiot zamówienia przez odniesienie do norm, ocen technicznych, specyfikacji technicznych i systemów referencji technicznych, o których mowa w art. 101 ust. 4 PZP, Zamawiający dopuszcza rozwiązania równoważne opisanym, a wskazane odniesienia należy odczytywać z wyrazami „lub równoważne”. 3.3.5. Wykonawca jest obowiązany wykazać w ofercie, że proponowane rozwiązania w równoważnym stopniu spełniają wymagania określone w OPZ. 3.4. re części zamówienia zostaną udzielone jednemu Wykonawcy, w przypadku wyboru jego oferty w większej niż maksymalna liczbie części: 4.1. Zamówienie nie zostało podzielone na części. 4.2. Zamawiający nie dopuszcza składania ofert częściowych. Strona 6 z 23 Dokument dostosowany do standardów WCAG Zamawiający nie dokonuje podziału zamówienia na części, ponieważ przedmiot zamówienia stanowi funkcjonalnie i technicznie spójną całość, obejmującą zaprojektowanie, wykonanie, wdrożenie, hosting i utrzymanie strony internetowej, BIP oraz wspólnego systemu CMS, wraz z migracją treści i przygotowaniem środowiska dla systemu rejestracji czasu pracy. Podział zamówienia pomiędzy kilku wykonawców powodowałby konieczność koordynowania wzajemnie powiązanych prac oraz zwiększał ryzyko problemów z integracją, kompatybilnością i odpowiedzialnością za ewentualne nieprawidłowości. Powierzenie realizacji całości jednemu wykonawcy zapewnia spójność technologiczną oraz jednoznaczną odpowiedzialność za prawidłowe wykonanie i funkcjonowanie rozwiązania. 5. Στο αντικείμενο της σύμβασης περιλαμβάνεται η παροχή της απαιτούμενης υποδομής VMware, των αναγκαίων υπολογιστικών, αποθηκευτικών και δικτυακών πόρων, καθώς και η εγκατάσταση, παραμετροποίηση και λειτουργία της υπηρεσίας Disaster Recovery. Οι τεχνικές προδιαγραφές τόσο του Κέντρου Δεδομένων όσο και των υπηρεσιών περιγράφονται στο Έντυπο 9 - ΠΙΝΑΚΑΣ ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΜΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ. Η λύση θα υποστηρίζει τη συνεχή αναπαραγωγή (replication) των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών του Πανεπιστημίου προς το περιβάλλον του Αναδόχου, με χρήση του λογισμικού Veeam Backup and Replication, ώστε να διασφαλίζεται η δυνατότητα ανάκτησης των κρίσιμων πληροφοριακών συστημάτων σε περίπτωση σοβαρής διακοπής λειτουργίας ή καταστροφής του κύριου Κέντρου Δεδομένων του Πανεπιστημίου Κύπρου. Στόχος είναι η συνέχιση της παροχής υπηρεσιών μέσω διαδικτύου προς την Πανεπιστημιακή κοινότητα και το κοινό, με τον ελάχιστο δυνατό χρόνο διακοπής. Η λύση θα πρέπει να παρέχει τη δυνατότητα ενεργοποίησης (failover) των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών στο περιβάλλον του Αναδόχου όταν και εφόσον κριθεί αναγκαίο, καθώς και δυνατότητα ασφαλούς επαναφοράς (failback) στο κύριο Κέντρο Δεδομένων του Πανεπιστημίου μετά την αποκατάσταση

ουσας Αρχής. Κατά τη διάρκεια της επίσκεψης, τα άτομα της Αναθέτουσας Αρχής θα έχουν συναντήσεις με τους αρμόδιους μηχανικούς του DR Datacenter και θα παρουσιαστούν η υποδομή και η αρχιτεκτονική του χώρου, οι μηχανισμοί πλεονασμού και διαθεσιμότητας, καθώς και οι διαδικασίες Disaster Recovery. Παράλληλα, θα παρουσιαστούν οι διαδικασίες replication, failover/failback και αποκατάστασης των συστημάτων σε περίπτωση καταστροφής ή διακοπής λειτουργίας. Ο Ανάδοχος πρέπει να συμπεριλάβει στην προσφορά του όλα τα τυχών έξοδα για την επίσκεψη (κόστος μεταφοράς, διαμονής, γεύματα κτλ.). Παραμετροποίηση Υπηρεσίας Disaster Recovery: VMware as a service, Veeam Configuration, initial replication Διαμόρφωση των μηχανισμών replication μέσω του λογισμικού Veeam, της εφαρμογής των απαιτούμενων πολιτικών προστασίας, καθώς και της ασφαλούς διασύνδεσης με την υφιστάμενη υποδομή του Πανεπιστημίου, σύμφωνα με τη Μελέτη Εφαρμογής. Υλοποίηση της αρχικής αντιγραφής των δεδομένων και των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών από το κύριο κέντρο δεδομένων προς το περιβάλλον DR. Περιλαμβάνεται η ρύθμιση των μηχανισμών replication, ο έλεγχος της ορθής μεταφοράς των δεδομένων και λειτουργίας και η επιβεβαίωση της ετοιμότητας του περιβάλλοντος για ενεργοποίηση σε περίπτωση καταστροφής. L’intervention des cordistes est interdite et nécessite l’utilisation d’une nacelle automotrice pilotée par des personnels certifiés munis de moyens de protection individuelle normalisés. (Voir article “ Etablissement des Plans de prévention des risques”) La méthode de pose est la s

isée suivant les mesures de prévention indiqué au plan de prévention, à l’écart de la circulation du public. La pose de filets de protection n’est pas nécessaire. La circulation de la nacelle sur Piazza se fait par la voie de circulation dite « Pompier ». 2.2.2.3- - Dépose/Pose des bâches (B) de la BO.3a et BO.3b : Même caractéristique que la méthode de dépose /pose (article 2.2.2.1) Ces bâches sont fixées sur une structure existante composée de quatre câbles gainés fixés sur une structure métallique rigide. En l’état actuel, le module de stockage est positionné à proximité de la chenille. Il est nécessaire de formuler la demande de déplacement du module de lavage 8 jours ouvrables avant la date d’intervention, au responsable du marché. La bâche BO.3 se fixe depuis une nacelle de 60 m stationnée sur la Piazza Pompidou, dans une zone à baliser et à surveiller strictement. La pose d’un filet de protection ou replis de la bâche existante est indispensable sur la chenille en verre pour protection. e von 16 Ver- braucherzentralen und mehr als 30 verbraucherpolitischen Verbänden – darunter über 2.000 Orga- nisationen und sieben Millionen Einzelmitglieder - für einen starken Schutz der Verbraucher:innen in Deutschland. Der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband ist die Stimme der Verbraucher:innen – und damit eine entscheidende Kraft in der Politik. Wir wissen, was Verbraucher:innen bewegt und verschaffen ihnen Gehör bei Politik, Wirtschaft und Verwaltung. Strukturelle Missstände decken wir auf, benennen Verbraucherprobleme und entwickeln Lösungen. So tragen wir dazu bei, dass Märkte transparent und gerecht gestaltet werden. II. Ausgangslage Zur Selbstdarstellung und zur Unterstützung der politischen Interessenvertretung veröffentlicht der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband regelmäßig zahlreiche Kommunikationsmaterialien. Dazu zählen Publikationen, Social-Media-Grafiken, Flyer, Visuals für Veranstaltungen und Kampagnen sowie digi- tale Formate. Im Juli 2025 wurde die neue Marke Verbraucherzentrale mit einem überarbeiteten Corporate Design eingeführt. Grundlage hierfür ist die strategische Positionierung der Marke Verbraucherzentrale. Das neue Corporate Design setzt klare und verbindliche Gestaltungsstandards für die Kommunikation und unterstützt einen einheitlichen, zeit

ung. So können auch kurzfristige oder zeitkritische Projekte zuverläs- sig umgesetzt werden. Ziel der Ausschreibung ist daher der Abschluss eines Rahmenvertrags für Grafikleistungen mit zwei Losen. III. Laufzeit und Umfang des Rahmenver- trags Die zu schließenden Verträge für Grafikleistungen (Los I und Los II) haben eine Laufzeit vom 01.01.2027 bis 31.12.2028. Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband e.V. 5 | 17 Leistungsbeschreibung (Anlage 1) 2026-0997 Darüber hinaus enthalten die Verträge zwei einseitige Verlängerungsoptionen für den Zeitraum vom 01.01.2029 bis 31.12.2029 und vom 01.01.2030 bis 31.12.2030. Die maximal mögliche Vertragslauf- zeit endet am 31.12.2030. Der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband hat das Recht, die Verträge durch einseitige schriftliche Erklärung bis zum 30.09. des jeweiligen Vorjahres zu verlängern, d.h. die Leistungen zu den angebo- tenen Bedingungen auch für die Jahre 2029 und 2030 zu beauftragen. Der Verbraucherzentrale Bun- desverband ist nicht dazu verpflichtet, die Optionen abzurufen. Die Ausschreibung besteht aus zwei Losen. Los I (vgl. entity_geography.text: 2_Eigenerklaerung_Bezug_Russland-0422.docx ===== Entsprechend der Verordnung (EU) 2022/576 dürfen öffentlichen Aufträge und Konzessionen nach dem 9. April 2022 nicht an Personen oder Unternehmen vergeben werden, die einen Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift aufweisen. Dies umfasst sowohl unmittelbar als Bewerber, Bieter oder Auftragnehmer auftretende Personen oder Unternehmen als auch mittelbar, mit mehr als zehn Prozent, gemessen am Auftragswert, beteiligte Unterauftragnehmer, Lieferanten oder Eignungsverleiher. Ein Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift besteht durch die russische Staatsangehörigkeit des Bewerbers/Bieters oder die Niederlassung des Bewerbers/Bieters in Russland, durch die Beteiligung einer natürlichen Person oder eines Unternehmens, auf die eines der Kriterien nach Buchstabe a zutrifft, am Bewerber/Bieter über das Halten von Anteilen im Umfang von mehr als 50 Prozent, durch das Handeln der Bewerber/Bieter im Namen oder auf Anweisung von Personen oder Unternehmen, auf die die Kriterien der Buchstaben a und/oder b zutreffen. Bereits vor dem 9. April 2022 geschlossene Verträge mit solchen Personen oder Unternehmen mit Bezug zu Russland dürfen nur bis zum 10. Oktober 2022 fortgeführt werden. Protecting our environment is a huge responsibility, and we work with a number of organisations that carry out specific environmental functions. As of August 2014, we are also responsible for ensuring that the people of Ireland are protected from the harmful effects of radiation. Meilensteinplanung, der vorsieht innerhalb von 24 Monaten ab Erstellung des Maßnahmenplanes ein C5-Typ2-Testat zu erhalten. Sofern Cloud-Dienste zum Einsatz kommen, sind diese Vorgaben vom Hosting-Anbieter (auch als Unterauftragnehmer) ebenfalls zu erfüllen und nachzuweisen. Der für die Leistung relevante Scope des Testats ist einzubeziehen und nachzuweisen. Die betriebliche Weiterentwicklung der Systeme erfolgt unter Berücksichtigung der Empfehlungen aus der Architekturverantwortung des AN sowie der Vorgaben des ZDF. Die Umsetzung der jeweils zu beauftragenden Leistung erfolgt gemäß dem durch den ZDF-seitigen Projektleiter festzulegenden Vorgehensmodell, das auf die Notwendigkeiten des Projektes oder Vorhabens anzupassen und abzustimmen ist. Die Beauftragung und die Abrechnung erfolgen bei Bedarf im Rahmen des jeweiligen Projekts in Abstimmung mit und nach Freigabe durch den AG. Die zu erbringenden IT-Vorhaben werden im Q1 des Abrechnungsjahres als Grobplanung für den Zeitraum von 365 Tagen zwischen dem AN und AG abgestimmt. Diese Möglichkeit besteht unabhängig von der Rechtsna- tur der zwischen dem Bewerber und den anderen Unternehmen bestehenden Verbindun- gen. In diesem Fall ist der Vergabestelle nachzuweisen, dass dem Bewerber die erforderli- chen Mittel tatsächlich zur Verfügung stehen werden, indem beispielsweise eine entspre- chende Verpflichtungserklärung dieses Unternehmens vorgelegt wird. Zudem sind die Erklärungen über das Vorliegen von Ausschlussgründen nach § 123 Abs. 1 bis 4 GWB und § 124 Abs. 1 GWB auch für diese Unternehmen vorzulegen. Duration of a supplier’s qualification A supplier's qualification is valid for a term of 5 years. After the 5-year period, the qualification may be extended for the same period after the administrative and/or technical files are updated. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. The supplier shall submit the new administrative and/or technical file within 2 months. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. The qualified supplier must continue to meet all qualification conditions/criteria throughout the qualification period. Examples of such activities include adding green spaces, making it easier to get around the city and provide better access to health care – all goals of Wroclaw’s strategy for 203017 backed by the city and the EU funding for projects. Many data points show that these efforts are bearing fruit. The metropolitan area of Wroclaw is growing, with now over 2 million people living within an hour’s drive. Foreigners are also entering the local job market, with almost 61,00018 of them registered in the state social insurance (ZUS) system. More importantly, businesses are taking advantage of the improvements. A 2019 survey19 showed that 82% of large IT corporations in Wroclaw chose the city because of the access it gave to qualified workers. In the case of international production companies, this rate can reach even higher. All respondents in the digital industry study pointed to the availability of skilled labour as a crucial factor behind their decision to launch an investment in Lower Silesia20. PRODUCT PERSONALISATION AND SERVITISATION The ability to create more product variants while using the same resources is crucial to building a competitive advantage. That’s why increasing production flexibility has long been a pressing matter for manufacturers. Again, data is the game-changer here. Processing real-time information at all stages of user interactions enables creating product simulations that can be adapted to match unique, individual requirements of the customer. Similarly, many manufacturing businesses now expand the value for their clients by shifting from selling products to selling Product-Service Systems (PSS). Pioneered in the 1960s by Rolls Royce, servitisation relieves customers of capital costs, instead offering them advanced solutions in a subscription model. 16 PLATFORMISATION OF PRODUCTION Just as products are now increasingly offered as a service, the manufacturing process is also subject to similar changes. ON INDUSTRY 4.0 WORLDWIDE Before the outbreak of COVID-19, there was widespread interest in Industry 4.0. The sector’s value was projected to grow up to $3.7 trillion by 20259. However, despite these positive outlooks, the actual landscape of Industry 4.0 adoption has been far more complex. ASPIRATIONS VS REALITY 90% of respondents in McKinsey’s10 annual survey admitted seeing the benefits of digital transformation in manufacturing. A majority of them included introducing new technologies as an essential part of their organisational development strategies. However, as research from the World Economic Forum11 demonstrates, despite these declarations, the reality was still far from this ideal. In 2018, the adoption of technology in production still remained slow across industries and regions. ip_data_security.text: This change wouldn’t be possible without advancements such as the Internet of Things (IoT), the Cloud, Robotic Process Automation (RPA), or Artificial Intelligence (AI). 13 Therefore, this publication follows the BCG’s definition of Industry 4.01, seeing it as a transformation that enables analysing data across machines and using it for more efficient manufacturing at reduced costs. CORE TECHNOLOGIES SUPPORTING INDUSTRY 4.0 Autonomous robots & cobots Digital Twins & simulation The AI-powered cloud Augmented & virtual reality Digital integration systems The Industrial Internet of Things Additive manufacturing Big Data & analytics Cybersecurity * ORGANISED AFTER THE BOSTON CONSUL TING GROUP Apart from increasing productivity, Industry 4.0 also encourages developing new products and business models. As a result, it modifies the workforce profile and reconfigures the competitiveness of companies and regions. These issues will be discussed later on in this chapter but first, let’s focus on the three core advancements differentiating Industry 4.0 from the previous revolutions. DATIFICATION Integrating data from devices, sensors, and IT systems enables developing new solutions at all stages of the product lifecycle – from design to production, logistics and maintenance. 1

ntinuously collecting, analysing, and using data in real-time. IIoT enables monitoring of all production processes and scheduling maintenance accordingly. When integrating Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and Customer Relationship Management (CRM), the network allows for comprehensive management of all related operations. THE CONVERGENCE OF IT SYSTEMS AND OPERATIONAL TECHNOLOGY (OT) In the past, IT and OT worked as separate entities: the first one mostly serving management, the latter controlling machines and resources. Thanks to the IIoT, these two worlds have been increasingly converging. Cyber-physical systems (CPS) embody this tendency as machines now combine both the IT and operational qualities. One of the most advanced CP systems – Digital Twins – enables creating digital replicas of physical objects but also processes based on data collected from sensors. ROBOTISATION AND AUTOMATION Industry 4.0 is also underpinned by a growing level of robotisation and automation. Apart from automated production lines, factories now boast autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and collaborative robots (cobots). EBVPD – Europos bendrasis viešųjų pirkimų dokumentas, aktuali deklaracija, pakeičianti kompetentingų institucijų išduodamus dokumentus ir preliminariai patvirtinanti, kad tiekėjas ir ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais jis remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį (VPĮ 88 straipsnio 5 dalies nuostatų taikymo atvejais ir subtiekėjai), atitinka pirkimo dokumentuose pagal VPĮ 46, 47, 48 straipsnius nustatytus reikalavimus ir, jeigu taikytina, 54 straipsnyje nustatytus reikalavimus dėl kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartų laikymosi, kurio forma prieinama interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Įgaliotoji organizacija – pirkimams organizuoti, pirkimo procedūroms iki sutarties ar preliminariosios sutarties sudarymo atlikti, taip pat atlikto pirkimo procedūrų ataskaitai ar skelbimui apie sudarytą sutartį ar preliminariąją sutartį pateikti perkančiosios organizacijos įgaliota organizacija, nurodyta specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose. Komisija – viešojo pirkimo komisija. Perkančioji organizacija – specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nurodyta perkančioji organizacija. Pirkimas – perkančiosios organizacijos atliekamas viešasis pirkimas. Preliminarioji sutartis – preliminarioji viešojo pirkimo-pardavimo sutartis (jei taikoma), vienos ar k

PĮ 49 straipsnį (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato tiekėjo kvalifikacijos reikalavimus); pasiūlymo teikimo metu žinomi subtiekėjai (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato reikalavimus dėl subtiekėjų pašalinimo pagrindų). fiziniai asmenys, kuriuos tiekėjas ketina įdarbinti Pirkimo laimėjimo atveju ir kurių pajėgumais tiekėjas remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 (kvazisubtiekėjai) (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato reikalavimus dėl fizinių asmenų, kurių kvalifikacija tiekėjas remiasi ir kuriuos, pirkimo laimėjimo atveju, tiekėjas ketina įdarbinti, pašalinimo pagrindų). EBVPD pildomas jį įkėlus interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Tiekėjas, pildydamas EBVPD, laukelyje „Procedūros tipas“ turi pasirinkti „Atvira“. Teikdamas pasiūlymą CVP IS priemonėmis šį EBVPD tiekėjas turi pridėti kartu su kitais pasiūlymo dokumentais (pasiūlymo pateikimo skiltyje „Prisegti dokumentus“). EBVPD nurodytą informaciją pagrindžiantys dokumentai kartu su pasiūlymu neteikiami. Perkančioji organizacija bet kuriuo pirkimo procedūros metu gali paprašyti dalyvių pateikti visus ar dalį dokumentų, patvirtinančių jų pašalinimo pagrindų nebuvimą, atitiktį kvalifikacijos reikalavimams ir, jeigu taikytina, kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartams, jeig

(e) Cesiune - înțelegere scrisă prin care Contractantul transferă unei terțe părți, în condițiile Legii nr. 98/2016, drepturile și/sau obligațiile deținute prin Contract sau parte din acestea; (f) Conflict de interese - orice situație influențând capacitatea Contractantului de a exprima o opinie profesională obiectivă și imparțială sau care îl împiedică pe acesta, în orice moment, s

Autoritatea contractantă notifică Contractantului decizia sa cu privire la înlocuirea unui Subcontractant/implicarea unui nou Subcontractant, motivând decizia sa în cazul respingerii aprobării. 15.5. Contractantul se obligă să încheie Contracte de Subcontractare doar cu Subcontractanții care își exprimă acordul cu privire la obligațiile contractuale asumate de către Contractant prin prezentul Contract. 10 15.6. Niciun Contract de Subcontractare nu creează raporturi contractuale între Subcontractant și Autoritatea contractantă. Contractantul este pe deplin răspunzător față de Autoritatea contractantă pentru modul în care îndeplinește Contractul. Contractantul răspunde pentru actele și faptele Subcontractanților săi ca și cum ar fi actele sau faptele Contractantului. Aprobarea de către Autoritatea contractantă a subcontractării oricărei părți a Contractului sau a angajării de către Contractant a unor Subcontractanți pentru anumite părți din Contract nu eliberează Contractantul de niciuna dintre obligațiile sale din Contract. 15.7. În prelucrarea datelor cu caracter personal conform Contractului, Părțile se angajează să respecte toate obligațiile stabilite conform legislației privind protecția datelor cu caracter personal inclusiv, dar fără limitare, conform prevederilor Regulamentu lui nr. 679/2016 privind protecția persoanelor fizice în ceea ce privește prelucrarea datelor cu caracter personal și privind libera circulație a acestor date și de abrogare a Directivei 95/46/CE (“GDPR”). 17.4. În contextul încheierii și executării Contractului, Părțile vor putea prelucra o serie de date cu caracter personal, precum datele de identificare și datele de contact de tipul nume, prenume, funcția ocupată, adresă de email, număr de telefon, semnătură a le persoanelor fizice desemnate în mod direct sau indirect, de către oricare dintre Părți în calitate de persoane de contact în vedere executării contractului precum și datele de identificare și date de contact ale administratorilor, di

n măsura în care Contractantul nu a dat curs solicitării de remediere conform pct. (i). În această situație plata aferentă costurilor remedierii vor fi suportate din garanția de bună exe cuție, Contractantul fiind obligat să o reîntregească în termen de 5 zile lucrătoare de la data la care i s-a comunicat efectuarea deducerii de către Autoritatea contractanta. 14 18.9. În ipoteza în care Autoritatea contractantă a refuzat/a făcut obiecții doar în privința unei cantități parțiale de bunuri și a acordat Contractantului dreptul de a înlocui/remedia deficiențele bunului, aceasta are dreptul de a rezoluționa parțial contractu l, doar în ceea ce privește bunurile care nu au fost preluate sau în privința cărora s-au solicitat remedieri, iar Contractantul nu le-a remediat. 18.10. În situația în care Autoritatea contractantă constată existența unor vicii/neconformități ascunse ale bunului, aceasta are obligația să le aducă la cunoștință Contractantului în termen de 5 zile lucrătoare de la momentul la care le-a descoperit. 18.11. În ipoteza în care viciile/neconformitățile ascunse vizează doar o parte din bunuri, Autoritatea are dreptul de a rezoluționa parțial contractul, în privința acestor bunuri în condițiile prezentului Contract. 18.12. Website Hosting & Support Service The objective of this tender process is to invite proposals for the provision of website hosting, ongoing maintenance and development services for the CORU website. Tenderers shall demonstrate their capability to provide a secure, reliable, and resilient hosting environment that supports the continued availability and performance of the website. Particular consideration will be given to: • The location of the hosting infrastructure and the suitability of the hosting arrangement from a regulatory, operational, and data governance perspective. • The provision of secure and user -friendly content management functionality that enables authorised CORU staff to undertake routine and moderate website content updates without requiring specialist technical support. • The implementation of appropriate security controls, monitoring, and maintenance processes to protect the website from unauthorised access, modification, disruption, or malicious activi

sla_onsite.text: CORU's operational, regulatory and strategic requirements. 3.3 Key Requirements Of The Website Hosting & Support Service 1. Website Migration Services The successful tenderer shall be responsible for the migration of CORU's existing live website to the proposed hosting environment. The migration service shall include, at a minimum: • Development and execution of a detailed migration plan, including timelines, responsibilities, testing and implementation activities. • Migration of all website content, functionality, configurations and associated assets to the proposed environment. • Measures to minimise disruption to website availability and user experience during the migration process. • Comprehensive testing prior to go -live, including functional, security, performance, accessibility and user acceptance testing. • Provision of rollback and recovery procedures in the event of migration issues. • Preservation of existing search engine rankings and implementation of any necessary redirects and SEO protections during migration. • Post-migration support to address any issues arising following implementation. CORU's website is currently hosted on the Umbraco Content Management System (CMS). Tenderers should indicate whether they propose to retain the existing CMS o

Be fully supported and regularly updated by the provider and software vendor. 9 2. Hosting Services The successful tenderer shall provide a managed hosting service for the CORU website. The proposed hosting solution shall: • Be hosted within the European Union, with hosting in Ireland preferred. • Be secure, resilient and scalable. • Support high availability and business continuity requirements. Include proactive monitoring and management of the hosting environment. • Include automated notifications and alerting for outages, service degradation, security incidents or attempted attacks. • Maintain a minimum service availability commitment of 99.9% excluding agreed scheduled maintenance periods. Tenderers shall provide details of: • Hosting location(s). • Primary and secondary hosting facilities and data centres. • Backup arrangements and retention periods. • Disaster recovery arrangements. staffing_team.text: vastutab kasutajaliidese kujunduse ja kasutajakogemuse eest. Tarkvaraarendaja: vastutab front-end ja back-end arenduse eest. Tarkvaraarendaja peab omama kogemust Drupali-põhiste veebilahenduste arendamisel või liidestamisel ning vähemalt ühe kaasaegse JavaScripti raamistikuga (nt React, Angular või Vue.js) töötamisel. Tarkvaraarendaja peab omama teadmisi ja praktilist kogemust WCAG 2.2 AA ligipääsetavusnõuete rakendamisel veebiarenduses. Testija: vastutab kvaliteedikontrolli ja testimise eest (võib olla kombineeritud disaineri või projektijuhi rolliga). Pakkuja peab pakkumises esitama meeskonnaliikmete nimed ja rollid ning iga rolli kohta CV Lisa 6 vormil. Meeskonnaliikmeid võib hankelepingu täitmise ajal vahetada, kuid sellest tuleb hankijat eelnevalt teavitada. Asendav meeskonnaliige peab vastama vähemalt samadele nõuetele, mis olid esitatud asendatavale liikmele. Kogu projektiga seotud suhtlus, dokumentatsioon ja aruandlus peavad toimuma eesti keeles. Lähtekoodi kommentaarid ja tehniline dokumentatsioon koostatakse inglise keeles. Lisaks pakkumuses nimetatud meeskonna liikmetele võib tekkida vajadus kaasata hankelepingu täitmisel täiendavaid spetsialiste. Teiste spetsialistide kaasamist ei pea kooskõlastama ja nende kaasamise eest ei rakendata eraldi ega kõrgemat tunnihinda

3 Introduction Since 2007 Switzerland and selected EU Member States have been striving to jointly reduce economic and social disparities in Europe. According to the motto ‘do good and make it known’, this manual encourages Switzerland’s partner states to share results an d make them visible. The aim of this manual is to define the responsibilities, strategies and tools to make the general public aware of Switzerland’s cooperation programmes and to ensure transparency as well as consistent communication in the partner states. The manual specifies the requirements related to communication on the Swiss contribution to selected EU Member States. It states the general requirements and best practices related to the development of a communication concept, communication tools and t he provision of meaningful visual material. It also sets out the technical requirements on the use of the logo. 4 1. Public relations in the partner states 1.1. Roles and responsibilities The responsibilities of the National Coordination Unit (NCU) and executing agencies (EAs) related to communication are set out in Chapter 13 of the Regulations. The NCU shall designate a communication manager1 who plays a key role in coordinating, designing, promoting and implementing public relations regardi

hat several EAs jointly organise a launch event or closing thematic conference across several support measures. Lessons learnt and ideas from the Swiss cooperation programme 2007–19 ▪ Thematic conferences: These events give visibility to Switzerland and enable the exchange of knowledge, expertise and best practices at the same time. Consider also inviting Swiss experts to strengthen bilateral relations. This is particularly suitable for innovative support measures or support measures with less tangible results. ▪ Support measure visits: If the support measure involves visible results such as the rehabilitation of buildings, local residents or journalists could be invited on a guided tour or for an open day. ▪ Contests, field trips or educational events for students or pupils: This is a good way to combine awareness raising with Swiss visibility and to involve the audience emotionally. The messages need to be adapted to the different age groups. ▪ Study visits to Switzerland: Organise them at the beginning of the support measures so that the exchange of experience is useful for the implementation of the support measures. insurance_bonds.text: , including the submission of the final Systems Audit Report, within the calendar year immediately following the financial year under review. For the avoidance of doubt, the final Systems Audit Report shall be submitted not later than six (6) months following the end of the financial year under review. The Systems Audit shall include, but not be limited to, a review of the billing system environment, billing processes and controls, user access management, segregation of duties, data integrity, billing accuracy, tariff configuration controls, customer account management controls, billing adjustments and exception handling procedures, revenue assurance controls, interface controls between systems, audit trails, change management procedures, reporting controls, business continuity arrangements, backup and recovery procedures, and compliance with applicable policies, procedures and regulatory requirements. The Committees Oaklee’s Board Committees provide focused oversight across key areas of organisational activity. The Housing Delivery Committee met three times during the reporting period. Its remit includes approving the housing development pipeline and projects, considering the feasibility of new business, and making recommendations to the Board for projects with large capital budget and borrowing implications. The Audit & Risk Committee met three times during the reporting period. Its remit is to provide oversight and assurance for the work of Oaklee and to advise the Board on risk management, as well as internal and external audit. The Housing Services Committee met three times during the reporting period. It provides oversight to the Board on resident, housing, customer, property and asset services. The Committee encourages Resident engagement and feedback, and provides a focus on qualitative outcomes and quantitative performance. Two Resident representatives are members of the Committee. The purpose of this procedure is to establish a Panel of Trainers for the provision of Training Services for the Local Enterprise Office in Leitrim County Council. LEO Leitrim is compiling a panel of trainers, from which future training programmes, workshops and seminars for a maximum of a 3 year period will be selected . Applications are invited from those with appropriate skills and experience that wish to be included in the LEO Leitrim Training panel. For the purposes of this document, the term “Trainer” refers to any Applicant admitted to the Panel and engaged by Local Enterprise Office Leitrim to deliver training services. References to Tenderer, Consultant or Applicant shall be interpreted accordingly. The proposed Training Services include but are not limited to those set out in section below. The Leitrim Local Enterprise Office serves as a first stop shop to provide support and services to start, grow and develop micro and small businesses in County Leitrim. LEO Leitrim Training Services are aimed at improving owner-manager skills to assist the survival and growth of micro- businesses. As per the Enterprise Development Plan, the provision of training is a fundamental aspect of LEO supports to entrepreneurs in the county. The Local Enterprise Office cur

embers capable of delivering the services [subject to that number being on the panel]. Mini competitions will be conducted in line with public procurement requirements and t he contract awarded on the basis of the most suitable trainer and the skills required for the project/approach to be delivered. As and when additional programmes arise over the life of the Panel, LEO Leitrim will either award these programmes to the initial firm identified to deliver the programme or identify the most appropriate service provider on the panel based on availability, reliability & quality of programme / trainer based on the specific needs and by reference to the original tenders. Other Requirements Which Arise LEO Leitrim recognises that training & business needs are constantly evolving and this in turn may require changes to our training offerings. Where new training requirements are identified, LEO Leitrim may run a mini-tender among the most suitable panel members based on changing needs emerging and by reference to the original tenders. LEO Leitrim reserves therefore, the right to run a mini -tender competition for additional training programmes falling within the scope of this contract at all times. Given the strategic partnership of this service, the Contracting Authority considers the creation of a Panel as the most appropriate and workable procurement process for the provision of eBooks. A Panel constitutes a means of assessing the financial and technical capacity of a number of economic operators to whom individual contracts may or may not be awarded over the Panel’s duration. The Contracting Authority is planning to run a two-stage tender process. In the initial stage, all providers who meet the Selection Criteria included in the Qualification Questionnaire Document will be admitted to the Panel. The second stage of this competition is Contracts. Contracts will be signed by the Contracting Authority with each provider, identifying the terms and conditions including the scope of the services, costs and any other operations terms required. Revenue requires a platform for 200 users that provides access to relevant, high -quality learning content on current technologies and industry practices. The platform should have a clear, intuitive catalogue that enables users to easily search for and access relevant learning materia ls. The Government shall have the right, without the prior written consent of the Contractor or its authorized resellers, to assign, reassign, or transfer software licenses among Government employees or the Government's rights in the Contractor's product to any governmental organization that is managed, operated, or controlled by the Government. Such authorization includes sublicensing, and assignment or transfer among or between authorized users. insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

entity_geography.text: ealthcare Training Services Contract or concession notice – standard regime 1 Buyer 1.1 Buyer Official name: Leading Healthcare Providers Skillnet Legal type of the buyer: Body governed by public law, controlled by a central government authority Activity of the contracting authority: Education 2 Procedure 2.1 Procedure Title: 2026 ­ 2028 Dynamic Purchasing System for Healthcare Training Services Description: LHP Skillnet is establishing a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) to facilitate the provision of services for the period 2026 to 2028. The DPS will provide an ongoing mechanism that allows suitably qualified suppliers who meet the minimum eligibility and quality thresholds to apply for admission at any time during the life of the system. Unlike a traditional framework agreement, the DPS is fully electronic and remains open throughout its duration. Once admitted to the DPS, suppliers may be invited to participate in mini competitions for specific training requirements as they arise. Contracts will be awarded following these mini competitions in accordance with the applicable procurement rules. The DPS will operate in line with the provisions of the relevant procurement directives and will remain in place for a period of three years. Suppliers may join or leave the DPS at any stage du

Commissioning: Commissioning is a process that involves the entire Design Team throughout the planning, design, construction and occupancy of the project. Commissioning Guidelines for AOC Projects are contained in the policy statement of June 7, 2010. During the initial planning process, the AOC Project Team shall determine the purpose and role of commissioning. The purpose may be to ensure proper integration of a small renovation/rehabilitation into the Capitol 7 AOC Order 28-8, December 26, 2018 complex, or it may be related to a certification. It may range from simple, direct Owner commissioning by the AOC to an independent Commissioning Agent with a substantial budget. As a rule, if a project is designed by an Associate A/E, then commissioning will be performed by a third party hired by the AOC. Within the context of design for mechanical systems, commissioning plays a significant role. The designer of the mechanical system has these responsibilities: i. Develop and document the Program of Requirements (PoR.) ii. Develop a basis of design. Commissioning shall help ensure that mechanical systems operate properly as a holistic system. To meet these ESR bunch injection schemes and requirements, an array of stripline-based kickers, individually fed by high voltage (HV) pulse signals of up to +/-30 kV, will be installed in the ESR. The required deflection angle is in the range 1- 1.5 mrad, for the individual stripline kicker we target a deflection angle of ~125 µrad @ 18 GeV, assuming +/-27 kV pulse supply voltage between the kicker electrodes. An Autotransfusion Units also known as an autologous blood recovery system, is a system that provides hospitals with an easy-to-use, reliable way to recover a patient’s own high-quality blood during medium to high blood loss procedures, including cardiac, orthopedic, trauma, transplant, vascular and OBGYN surgeries. Once recovered, the blood is washed and delivered to a product bag. The complete system is designed to be intuitive and flexible for optimal performance, supporting exceptional patient care. Jeżeli trwałe usunięcie podatności zależy od udostępnienia poprawki przez producenta komponentu, zmiana terminu wymaga udokumentowanego uzasadnienia, utrzymania skutecznego zabezpieczenia tymczasowego oraz pisemnej akceptacji Zamawiającego. Usunięcie podatności musi zostać potwierdzone ponowną weryfikacją i udokumentowane. Powyższe terminy obowiązują niezależnie od terminów obsługi awarii określonych w SLA i nie zmieniają warunków odbioru końcowego, w szczególności zakazu występowania podatności Critical i High. Wykonawca przystępuje do realizacji prac wyłącznie na podstawie zlecenia Zamawiającego, o którym mowa w ust. 8. Wykonanie prac objętych danym zleceniem podlega odbiorowi przez Zamawiającego, potwierdzanemu protokołem odbioru. Z chwilą podpisania protokołu odbioru dochodzi do odbioru prac objętych danym zleceniem. Do procedury odbioru stosuje się odpowiednio postanowienia § 3 ust. 2 i 3 umowy. estów oraz usunięcia stwierdzonych błędów przed odbiorem końcowym. entity_geography.text: σε πιστοποιημένο Κέντρο Δεδομένων επιπέδου Tier III, για 3 έτη, με δικαίωμα προαίρεσης για ακόμα 2 έτη. Στο αντικείμενο της σύμβασης περιλαμβάνεται η παροχή της απαιτούμενης υποδομής VMware, των αναγκαίων υπολογιστικών, αποθηκευτικών και δικτυακών πόρων, καθώς και η εγκατάσταση, παραμετροποίηση και λειτουργία της υπηρεσίας Disaster Recovery. Οι τεχνικές προδιαγραφές τόσο του Κέντρου Δεδομένων όσο και των υπηρεσιών περιγράφονται στο Έντυπο 9 - ΠΙΝΑΚΑΣ ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΜΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ. Η λύση θα υποστηρίζει τη συνεχή αναπαραγωγή (replication) των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών του Πανεπιστημίου προς το περιβάλλον του Αναδόχου, με χρήση του λογισμικού Veeam Backup and Replication, ώστε να διασφαλίζεται η δυνατότητα ανάκτησης των κρίσιμων πληροφοριακών συστημάτων σε περίπτωση σοβαρής διακοπής λειτουργίας ή καταστροφής του κύριου Κέντρου Δεδομένων του Πανεπιστημίου Κύπρου. Στόχος είναι η συνέχιση της παροχής υπηρεσιών μέσω διαδικτύου προς την Πανεπιστημιακή κοινότητα και το κοινό, με τον ελάχιστο δυνατό χρόνο διακοπής. Η λύση θα πρέπει να παρέχει τη δυνατότητα ενεργοποίησης (failover) των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών στο περιβάλλον του Αναδόχου όταν και εφόσον κριθεί αναγκαίο, καθώς και δυνατότητα ασφαλούς επαναφοράς (failback) στο κύριο Κέντρο Δεδομένων του Πανεπιστημίου μετά την αποκατάσταση

ουσας Αρχής. Κατά τη διάρκεια της επίσκεψης, τα άτομα της Αναθέτουσας Αρχής θα έχουν συναντήσεις με τους αρμόδιους μηχανικούς του DR Datacenter και θα παρουσιαστούν η υποδομή και η αρχιτεκτονική του χώρου, οι μηχανισμοί πλεονασμού και διαθεσιμότητας, καθώς και οι διαδικασίες Disaster Recovery. Παράλληλα, θα παρουσιαστούν οι διαδικασίες replication, failover/failback και αποκατάστασης των συστημάτων σε περίπτωση καταστροφής ή διακοπής λειτουργίας. Ο Ανάδοχος πρέπει να συμπεριλάβει στην προσφορά του όλα τα τυχών έξοδα για την επίσκεψη (κόστος μεταφοράς, διαμονής, γεύματα κτλ.). Παραμετροποίηση Υπηρεσίας Disaster Recovery: VMware as a service, Veeam Configuration, initial replication Διαμόρφωση των μηχανισμών replication μέσω του λογισμικού Veeam, της εφαρμογής των απαιτούμενων πολιτικών προστασίας, καθώς και της ασφαλούς διασύνδεσης με την υφιστάμενη υποδομή του Πανεπιστημίου, σύμφωνα με τη Μελέτη Εφαρμογής. Υλοποίηση της αρχικής αντιγραφής των δεδομένων και των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών από το κύριο κέντρο δεδομένων προς το περιβάλλον DR. Περιλαμβάνεται η ρύθμιση των μηχανισμών replication, ο έλεγχος της ορθής μεταφοράς των δεδομένων και λειτουργίας και η επιβεβαίωση της ετοιμότητας του περιβάλλοντος για ενεργοποίηση σε περίπτωση καταστροφής.
